title: A Study in Scarlet

vibeProfile.oneLine: Holmes and Watson meet, and modern detective fiction is born.

summary: The novel that introduced the world to Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson, as the two meet, take rooms at Baker Street, and tackle a baffling London murder whose roots reach back to the American frontier. Conan Doyle lays out, fully formed, the method that would define detective fiction: observation, deduction and the flourish of the reveal. A brisk, hugely enjoyable origin story, it is where a hundred years of crime writing effectively begins, and where Holmes first says more or less everything you remember him saying.
whyReadIt: Where Holmes and Watson first meet, and where detective fiction really begins. Brisk, clever and endlessly re-readable.

funFacts.text: Conan Doyle was paid just 25 pounds for all rights to this first Holmes story.
